newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofgas calls for cost reflective gas balancing.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofgas calls for cost reflective gas balancing.

text.p: UK natural gas industry regulator Ofgas wants to see the Network Code - the business rules governing gas supply through the national pipeline system - reflecting costs more accurately, the regulator said in a new document on Monday.
And pipeline operator Transco, part of BG plc, should have more control over the way the system is balanced, Ofgas added.
Transco is currently forced to follow the detailed rules of the Network Code when balancing the system. Ofgas said this has sometimes resulted in prices not reflecting actual market conditions.

Ofgas said it believed giving Transco more control over the system, as well as further openness and proper incentives, would lead to more effective system balancing and to prices which more accurately reflected supply and demand.
But Ofgas said it will not be possible to develop the recommendations in its document, 'The Gas balancing Regime: Conclusions' in time for this winter.
